bicep-curl.title: Barbell / Dumbbell Bicep Curl
bicep-curl.formCue: Pin elbows to ribcage and eliminate torso swing.

steps.instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Hold weights with supinated grip (palms facing forward). Pin elbows firmly against the sides of your ribcage, shoulders retracted and depressed.
Exhale and curl the weight upward toward shoulder level by flexing elbows. Keep upper arms completely motionless and perpendicular to floor. Torso remains strictly vertical without swinging.
Squeeze biceps firmly at top of range of motion (elbow angle ~35-45°). Do not allow wrists to hyperextend or shoulders to roll forward.
Inhale while lowering weights under strict control over a 2-3 second tempo until elbows reach full comfortable extension (~160-170°).

bodyweight-squat.title: Bodyweight Squat
bodyweight-squat.formCue: Sit back into heels, track knees over second toe, descend to parallel.

steps.instruction: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width, toes turned slightly outward (~10-15°). Depress and retract scapulae (pull shoulders down and back) with chest proud. Arms by your sides or held in front for counter-balance.
Stiffen abdominal core muscles ('bracing') to stabilize the lumbar spine. Shift body weight back into heels and mid-foot while preparing to hinge hips backward.

Initiate movement by sending hips backward and downward simultaneously. Track knees in direct line with the second toe. Avoid knee valgus (collapsing inward). Descend until thighs are parallel to floor (knee joint angle ~90°). Maintain parallel angle between shin (tibia) and torso.
Exhale while driving through heels and mid-foot. Hips and shoulders rise at the identical rate, keeping back straight. Squeeze glutes and quads at top without hyperextending lumbar spine.

forward-lunge.title: Forward Lunge
forward-lunge.formCue: Lower hips vertically; keep front knee stacked directly over ankle.

steps.instruction: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, shoulders pulled down and back, hands on hips or holding weights at sides. Core braced and chest held high.
Step forward with one leg, landing heel first then rolling onto full foot. Lower hips straight down vertically until both front and trailing knees are bent at approximately 90° angles.
Front knee is stacked directly above the front ankle and does not drift excessively past toes. Trailing knee hovers 1-2 inches above the floor without impacting the mat.
Exhale, push firmly through the front heel and mid-foot, and step backward in a single fluid motion to the starting upright position.

deadlift.title: Conventional Deadlift
deadlift.formCue: Hinge at hips with flat back; push floor away through heels.

steps.instruction: Stand behind the bar with feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward or slightly angled outward. Bar directly over mid-foot (1-2 inches from shins).
Hinge deeply at hips while keeping chest lifted and spine neutral. Grip bar outside shins with double-overhand or alternated grip. Depress lats ('pack the shoulders') to lock upper back.
Take a deep breath and brace core. Push the floor away through mid-foot and heels. Bar travels in a purely vertical linear path directly grazing the shins. Hips and chest rise together.
At top of pull, squeeze glutes and stand tall. Avoid hyperextending lower back. Return bar by hinging hips backward until bar passes knees, then bend knees to rest bar onto floor.
